name: Image Color Palette Extractor with Contrast Pairs

seo.title: Image Color Palette Extractor with Contrast Pairs — Browser-Local Tool
seo.meta_description: Extract dominant colours from a local image and rank palette pairs by WCAG-style contrast ratio.

assumptions: Pixels are downsampled before quantization to bound CPU and memory.
limitations: Dominant-colour clustering is approximate; contrast ratio alone does not guarantee overall interface accessibility.
